correctness.rationale: The elementary carry identity and digit formula hold for every position. Symmetry reduces it to b(nc_{j-1}+c_{j+1})=(n+1)c_j modulo n²−1. For each prime dividing n−1 the t≤q case propagates divisibility from c1, and the t>q case rules out a globally minimum nonzero carry valuation below the prime-power exponent. All endpoint, modulus, and gcd cases are included. Standard carry bounds force 0 or n−1, c1>0 then n+1|b. The reverse implication comes from Holt 2014 Theorem 6. Direct finite replay confirms examples and parameter slices.
